blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lucio Tan-led Philippine Airlines (PAL) is betting further on the Pacific travel market as it restores nonstop flights to Saipan, a US territory known for its beaches, diving sites and historical landmarks. In an advisory on Thursday, the flag carrier said it would relaunch the Manila-Saipan route on Oct. 25 using its Airbus A321ceo, which can seat 199 passengers across economy and business class.
